title: Modernization Plan
description: Phased migration plan produced after the user selects a migration option, with tasks linked to risk assessments and ordered by dependency.

selectedOptionId.description: Identifier of the chosen MigrationOptions entry.

phases.description: Ordered execution phases of the migration.

name.description: Short name for this phase (e.g. 'Scaffold build system').

description.description: Detailed description of what this phase accomplishes.

tasks.description: Individual work items within this phase.

taskId.description: Unique task identifier, referenced by ImplementationLog entries.

riskId.description: Reference to a RiskAssessment item filePath that this task relates to.

estimatedEffort.description: T-shirt size estimate of effort required.

dependencies.description: Phase numbers that must complete before this phase can start.
